arabic text: CHI KARBALA HAST IMRUZ, CHI PUR BALA HAST IMRUZ\nSARE HUSAYNE MADHLUUM, AZ TAN JUDA HAST IMRUZ
english translation text: WHAT IS AT KARBALA TODAY? WHAT CALAMITY ARE WE GOING THROUGH TODAY?\nTHE OPPRESSED IMAM HUSSAIN (AS) HAS BEEN BE-HEADED TODAY.

arabic text: ABBAAS BEHRE ASHAAB, MIKHWAST TAA BARD AAB\nEEN TIFLE SHAHARBANU PUR KHUUN CHERAA HAST IMRUZ
english translation text: ABBAS FOR THE COMPANIONS, WANTED TO BRING WATER\nTHIS NEWBORN OF SHAHRBANU, WHY IS HE COVERED IN BLOOD TODAY

arabic text: QAASIM E DAMAADAM CHISHUD, ABBAS DILAWAARAM CHISUD\nSARE HUSAYNE MADHLUUM, AZ TAN JUDA HAST IMRUZ
english translation text: WHAT HAPPENED TO QASIM MY GROOM, WHAT HAPPENED TO ABBAS MY HERO\nTHE OPPRESSED IMAM HUSSAIN (AS) HAS BEEN BE-HEADED TODAY

arabic text: AKBARE NAWJAWAN CHISHUD, ASGHARE BESHEER CHISHUD\nSARE HUSAYNE MADHLUUM, AZ TAN JUDA HAST IMRUZ
english translation text: WHAT HAPPENED TO AKBAR MY YOUNG ONE, WHAT HAPPENED TO ASGAR WHO DIDN'T HAVE ANY MILK\nTHE OPPRESSED IMAM HUSSAIN (AS) HAS BEEN BE-HEADED TODAY

arabic text: GOYA CHE ROZE MAHSHAR, DAR KARBALA HAST IMRUZ\nROZE AZA HAST IMRUZ JAR DAR BALA HAST IMRUZ
english translation text: THIS IS A DAY OF MOURNING, FULL OF GRIEF AND SORROW\nIT FEELS LIKE THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT HAS COME UPON KARBALA TODAY
